verdict.rationale: A recorded npm runtime probe shows the core `phaser` package is MIT-licensed, a permissive license that carries no royalties or per-install fees. The pricing page backs this up for the paid tooling: it lists "Full commercial rights" and says games you create are not linked to the licence, so they keep working if a subscription ends. Missing for 10: a first-party license page or docs explicitly stating no royalties or revenue share, independent or community corroboration of the licensing terms, and clarity on whether paid Editor/Agent subscriptions add any commercial-use conditions beyond "full commercial rights".
